M-GUIDANCE.NAME: Guidance packs
M-GUIDANCE.purpose: Search and retrieve domain guidance from local markdown packs or trust-gated CLI packs (ADR-12).

CrossLink.relation: trust gate, tokenizer and audit log for CLI packs

contract.purpose: Search and retrieve domain guidance from local markdown packs or trust-gated CLI packs (ADR-12).

param.name: root
param.description: Project root; local packs must live inside it.

param.name: content
param.description: Retrieved markdown text, tagged local or cli.

error.description: A pack is missing, invalid, disabled or untrusted; reported as info.
Unknown pack/id or a local path escaping the project root.

notes.note-1: CLI packs follow the Modern Web Guidance search/retrieve protocol but are not tied to it.
notes.note-2: Local guide files are read only inside the pack directory; traversal is rejected.
notes.note-3: mygrace.guidance-lock.json records local SHA-256, CLI command hashes/versions and optional package digests; optional Ed25519 signature attests the lockfile. Enforced automatically.
notes.note-4: CLI commands with mutable specs (`@latest`/bare npx) are reported as GUIDANCE_PACK_UNPINNED; docs/examples use pinned versions.
Guidance text is untrusted input: MyGRACE never executes or persists it automatically.
